design.decision: Draw trumps, then run a long suit. This reward pushes a team to bid big.
design.opponent: Shown when reached. Opponents keep a late trump to break the run.
design.rationale: This is a narrow streak condition (seed five-row fires 25%) at a common +mult amount. It ties Streaks to Bid High, since five-trick runs come from strong hands.
design.draftText: +15 contract multiplier when your team wins five tricks in a row

critic.concerns: Inverted ladder: harder condition (five in a row) at common than seed-four-row (four in a row, uncommon); threshold near-duplicate of cb-three-row-mult.
